content.comment_body: Hello everyone, This is my first time working with [product_name] and I am currently having trouble with [product_name] ([article_no]). I want to modify the time settings in the weekly timer blocks B001 and B002, and also change values in the analog MUX block for the required frequency. Although I can view these values on my [product_name], I am unable to edit them since there is no cursor or method to select the value for adjustment. How can this be achieved with [product_name]? I have attached my configuration. Thanks in advance for any help.

To modify a parameter, start by selecting the relevant message text. Once selected, hold down the ESC key for more than 2 seconds. This will display a black bar within the input/output field. Use the up/down keys to navigate among available fields. After selecting the field to change, press OK (on [product_name], typically Enter). The black bar will change to a blinking box. Then, use up/down to adjust the value, or left/right to move between digits. When finished, press OK again to return to the black bar. You can then use up/down to select another field, or press ESC to exit the editing mode.
Thank you, this resolved my issue. I wasn't aware of the need to hold the ESC button for 2 seconds. Appreciate your help!

analysis.insight_summary: Users experienced difficulty figuring out how to edit variable values on the [product_name] hardware, particularly with specific timer and analog MUX blocks. The main usability challenge involved discovering the method for accessing value editing controls, such as holding down the ESC key, which was not clearly indicated on the device interface.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to intuitively adjust variable values directly on the [product_name] panel, without relying on external instructions or prior knowledge. The process should be simple, with clear indications or easy-to-access controls for making parameter changes.
